```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"All children have a Constitutional right to go to school.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect sensitive locations like schools from immigration enforcement actions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe English learners bring an asset, rather than a deficit, to school.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats recognize the need for significantly increased funding and support for English learners to ensure they can participate meaningfully and equally in school.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the civil rights of limited English proficient parents so they receive information in the language they understand and are able to meaningfully participate in their child's education, including through public meetings and community decision-making mechanisms.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in providing equal educational opportunities for students with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fully fund the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act and fully implement its requirements for a free appropriate public education and least restrictive environment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support aggressive enforcement of Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the integration mandate of the Olmstead decision, and provide school districts with additional resources to better serve students with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ban seclusion and prevent and decrease use of physical restraint, in partnership with teachers, school administrators, and the disability rights movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support aggressive enforcement of the Americans with Disabilities Act in schools and other settings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
